rows=[r for r in csv.DictReader(open(VALUES_CSV)) if r['timeseries_id']==tid]
vals=[(r['timestamp'], float(r['value'])) for r in rows]
print("total", len(vals))
hi=max(v for _,v in vals)
half=hi/2
day2018_04_20=[(ts,v) for ts,v in vals if ts.startswith('2018-04-20')]
print("2018-04-20 count:", len(day2018_04_20))
print("highest:", hi, "half:", half)
print("day vals:", day2018_04_20)
above=sum(1 for ts,v in day2018_04_20 if v>half)
print("ABOVE (strict):", above)
above2=sum(1 for ts,v in day2018_04_20 if v>=half)
print("ABOVE (>=):", above2)
